info.name: ORDisplayPlugin
info.description:
Postman collection for ORDisplayPlugin — stage-2 mapper that reshapes ORScribe analyze/case JSON onto OR views (timeline, meds, counts, WHO checklist, roles).

No request headers required.

**Setup**
1. Import this collection.
2. Set baseUrl (default http://localhost:8032).
3. Run **Reshape — ORScribe analyze (all views)**.

request.description: Paste ORScribe POST /api/v1/analyze JSON into stage1_output. Seeded views map timeline, meds, counts, checklist, and roles.
